# C306

This is an independently maintained version of C306, based on
[oucru-biostats/C306](https://github.com/oucru-biostats/C306).

C306 collects the R tools used by the Biostatistics group of the Oxford
University Clinical Research Unit (OUCRU) to analyse and report clinical
studies:

- **report tables**: baseline characteristics, adverse events, and
  time-to-event comparisons (Cox, Fine–Gray, restricted mean survival
  time, cumulative incidence), overall and by subgroup, as flextables
  (Word, HTML, PDF) or plain matrices;
- **model summaries**: odds ratios with likelihood-ratio or Wald CIs,
  also within subgroups of an interacting variable;
- **plots**: Aalen–Johansen curves for competing risks, Box–Cox profile
  likelihood;
- **data tools**: import an OUCRU data dictionary, format raw data with
  it, and check the data for missing and out-of-range values.

## Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("TranHung93/306")
```

## Quick start

``` r

library(C306)
library(survival)

bl <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "baseline_data.csv", package = "C306"))
```

**Baseline table.** Each row variable is summarised by arm: continuous
variables with the statistics you ask for, categorical variables as n
(%).

``` r

tab <- sstable.baseline(age + sex + icudays ~ Arm, data = bl,
                        statistics = "median (Q1-Q3)", test = TRUE)
show_table(tab$table)
```

| Characteristic | n | Sham procedure (N=135) Summary statistic | n | Intrathecal treatment (N=136) Summary statistic | p value |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| age | 135 | 49 (38-58) | 136 | 49 (38-60) | 0.896 |
| sex | 135 |  | 136 |  | 0.879 |
| \- F |  | 27 (20%) |  | 26 (19%) |  |
| \- M |  | 108 (80%) |  | 110 (81%) |  |
| icudays | 134 | 18 (12-27) | 135 | 15 (11-22) | 0.0335 |

Add `flextable = TRUE` (or call `ss_flextable(tab)`) for a formatted
table that can be saved with
[`flextable::save_as_docx()`](https://davidgohel.github.io/flextable/reference/save_as_docx.html).

**Adverse events.** Number of episodes and of patients with at least one
event, by arm:

``` r

ae <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "ae_data.csv", package = "C306"))
tab <- sstable.ae(ae_data = ae, fullid_data = bl, id.var = "usubjid",
                  aetype.var = "ctcaename", grade.var = "ctcaegrade",
                  arm.var = "Arm", flextable = FALSE)
show_table(tab$table, rows = 1:6)
```

| Type of adverse event | n episode | Sham procedure (N=135) n patient | n episode | Intrathecal treatment (N=136) n patient | p value |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Any selected adverse event | 222 | 81 (60%) | 312 | 91 (67%) | 0.237 |
| \- Grade I | 101 | 56 (41%) | 143 | 67 (49%) |  |
| \- Grade II | 72 | 46 (34%) | 96 | 53 (39%) |  |
| \- Grade III | 29 | 25 (19%) | 52 | 32 (24%) |  |
| \- Grade IV | 17 | 14 (10%) | 18 | 16 (12%) |  |
| \- Grade N/A | 3 | 3 (2%) | 3 | 3 (2%) |  |

**Time to event.** Events, absolute risk, hazard ratio and median
survival:

``` r

lung2 <- transform(na.omit(lung[, c("time", "status", "sex")]),
                   arm = factor(sex, labels = c("Male", "Female")))
tab <- sstable.survcomp(Surv(time, status) ~ arm, data = lung2, flextable = FALSE)
show_table(tab$table)
```

| Endpoint | Female (n=90) events/n (risk \[%\]) | Male (n=138) events/n (risk \[%\]) | Comparison HR (95%CI); p-value | Test for proportional hazards p-value |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| status | 53/90 (91.68) | 112/138 (96.43) | 0.59 (0.42, 0.82); p=0.00149 | 0.0906 |
| time |  |  |  |  |
| \- Median (95%CI) | 426.00 (348.00, 550.00) | 270.00 (212.00, 310.00) |  |  |
| \- Lower IQR (95%CI) | 226.00 (186.00, 340.00) | 144.00 (107.00, 177.00) |  |  |
| \- Upper IQR (95%CI) | 687.00 (550.00, NA) | 457.00 (387.00, 574.00) |  |  |

Use `compare.method = "rmst"` for a restricted mean survival time
comparison,
[`sstable.survcomp.subgroup()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/sstable.survcomp.subgroup.md)
for subgroup analyses, and a competing-risks outcome
(`Surv(time, event)` with a factor `event`) for Fine–Gray models.

## Main functions

| Area | Functions |
|----|----|
| Report tables | [`sstable.baseline()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/sstable.baseline.md), [`sstable.ae()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/sstable.ae.md), [`sstable.survcomp()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/sstable.survcomp.md), [`sstable.survcomp.subgroup()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/sstable.survcomp.subgroup.md) |
| Formatting tables | [`ss_flextable()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ss_flextable.md), [`ss_huxtable()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ss_huxtable.md), [`as_sstable()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/as_sstable.md), [`ss_format()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ss_format.md), [`ft_sstheme()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ft_sstheme.md), [`ht_theme_markdown()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ht_theme_markdown.md), [`ht_theme_kable()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ht_theme_kable.md), [`rbind()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/cbind.html) |
| Models | [`logist_summary()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/logist_summary.md), [`subgroup_effect()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/subgroup_effect.md), [`explicit()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/explicit.md) |
| Plots | [`gg_ajsurvplot()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/gg_ajsurvplot.md), [`gg_ajsurvplot2()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/gg_ajsurvplot2.md), [`ggsurvfit2()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ggsurvfit2.md), [`tidy_survfit2()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/tidy_survfit2.md), [`gg_boxcox()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/gg_boxcox.md) |
| Data tools | [`import.info()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/import.info.md), [`convert.info()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/convert.info.md), [`myformat.data()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/myformat.data.md), [`inspect.data()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/inspect.data.md), [`getlabel()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/getlabel.md), [`labAE()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/labAE.md), [`createProject()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/createProject.md) |
| Helpers | [`contSummary()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/contSummary.md), [`pct()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/pct.md), [`simple_recode()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/simple_recode.md), [`simple_relevel()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/simple_relevel.md), [`simple_sort()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/simple_sort.md), [`ref_lv()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ref_lv.md), [`mutate_f()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/mutate_f.md), [`summarise_f()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/summarise_f.md) |

See
[`vignette("C306_vignette_v6", package = "C306")`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/articles/C306_vignette_v6.md)
for a detailed guide to the report tables, and `NEWS.md` for changes,
including the **impact of fixed bugs on previous reports**.

## Authors

Lam Phung Khanh, Trinh Dong Huu Khanh and Tran Thai Hung (maintainer),
with functions originally written by Marcel Wolbers.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ae_data`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ae_data.md) :
  Simulated adverse events of a two-arm trial
- [`as_sstable()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/as_sstable.md)
  : Coerce an object to sstable
- [`baseline_data`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/baseline_data.md)
  : Simulated baseline data of a two-arm trial
- [`contSummary()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/contSummary.md)
  : Calculate summary statistics for continuous variable
- [`convert.info()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/convert.info.md)
  : Convert imported OUCRU's data dictionary into a general data
  dictionary
- [`createProject()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/createProject.md)
  : Create project's folder based on pre-defined folder structure
- [`explicit()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/explicit.md)
  : Transform an object to its explicit form
- [`explicit(`*`<lm>`*`)`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/explicit.lm.md)
  : Transform a model to its explicit form
- [`ft_sstheme()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ft_sstheme.md)
  : Flextable theming for sstable
- [`getlabel()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/getlabel.md)
  : Obtain label of variable(s) based on metadata information
- [`gg_ajsurvplot()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/gg_ajsurvplot.md)
  : Plot the Aalen-Johansen curve with ggplot for competing risks
- [`gg_ajsurvplot2()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/gg_ajsurvplot2.md)
  : Plot 2 Aalen-Johansen curves with ggplot for competing risks
- [`gg_boxcox()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/gg_boxcox.md)
  : Compute and draw Box-Cox transformation plot for linear models using
  ggplot2
- [`ggsurvfit2()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ggsurvfit2.md)
  : ggsurvfit with strata saved
- [`ht_theme_kable()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ht_theme_kable.md)
  : A kable-esque theme for huxtable object
- [`ht_theme_markdown()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ht_theme_markdown.md)
  : A stripe theme for huxtable object
- [`import.info()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/import.info.md)
  : Import OUCRU's data dictionary into R
- [`inspect.data()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/inspect.data.md)
  : Check formatted data based on a pre-defined information
- [`labAE()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/labAE.md) :
  Identify new lab adverse event to report
- [`logist_summary()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/logist_summary.md)
  : An alternative summary for a logistic model with OR, CI, and
  p-values
- [`mutate_f()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/mutate_f.md)
  : Create or transform variables, with support for multiple assignment
- [`myformat.data()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/myformat.data.md)
  : Format data based on pre-defined information
- [`pct()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/pct.md) : Get the
  proportion for each level or range of a vector
- [`print(`*`<logist_summary>`*`)`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/print.logist_summary.md)
  : Print method for logist_summary
- [`print(`*`<ss_tbl>`*`)`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/print.ss_tbl.md)
  : Print an sstable matrix
- [`print(`*`<subgroup_logist_summary>`*`)`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/print.subgroup_logist_summary.md)
  : Print method for subgroup_logist_summary
- [`rbind(`*`<ss_obj>`*`)`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/rbind.ss_obj.md)
  [`rbind(`*`<ss_ae>`*`)`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/rbind.ss_obj.md)
  [`rbind(`*`<ss_survcomp>`*`)`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/rbind.ss_obj.md)
  [`rbind(`*`<ss_baseline>`*`)`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/rbind.ss_obj.md)
  : Row-binding two sstables
- [`ref_lv()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ref_lv.md)
  [`` `ref_lv<-`() ``](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ref_lv.md)
  : Get or set the reference level
- [`simple_recode()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/simple_recode.md)
  : Do a simple recode via pattern for data
- [`simple_relevel()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/simple_relevel.md)
  : Relevel in correspondence to another factor
- [`simple_sort()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/simple_sort.md)
  : Sort a vector in a user-defined order
- [`ss_body()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ss_body.md) :
  Designation of body part for custom sstable
- [`ss_flextable()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ss_flextable.md)
  : Create summary table using flextable package.
- [`ss_format()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ss_format.md)
  : Quick format a sstable in preparation for create flextable/huxtable
- [`ss_header()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ss_header.md)
  : Designation of header rows for custom sstable
- [`ss_huxtable()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ss_huxtable.md)
  : Create summary table using huxtable package.
- [`ss_section()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ss_section.md)
  : Designation of section title rows for custom sstable
- [`ss_template()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/ss_template.md)
  : Set template for sstable
- [`sstable.ae()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/sstable.ae.md)
  : Create an adverse event summary table
- [`sstable.baseline()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/sstable.baseline.md)
  : Create baseline table
- [`sstable.baseline.edit()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/sstable.baseline.edit.md)
  : Create baseline table
- [`sstable.survcomp()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/sstable.survcomp.md)
  : Summarize results for a Cox survival model or restricted mean
  survival time with the treatment arm as the main covariate
- [`sstable.survcomp.subgroup()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/sstable.survcomp.subgroup.md)
  : Summarize results for a survival model by treatment arm and subgroup
- [`subgroup_effect()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/subgroup_effect.md)
  : Calculation of covariable effects within each value of another
  covariable that has interaction
- [`summarise_f()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/summarise_f.md)
  : Reduce multiple values by summarisation functions.
- [`t(`*`<subgroup_logist_summary>`*`)`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/t.subgroup_logist_summary.md)
  [`` `[`( ``*`<subgroup_logist_summary>`*`)`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/t.subgroup_logist_summary.md)
  : Transpose a subgroup logist summary table
- [`tidy_survfit2()`](https://tranhung93.github.io/306/reference/tidy_survfit2.md)
  : Tidy survfit with strata save
